key_gap: On the style's home turf (an idealized scenario isolating a logical core — swimmer round trips in a uniform current) both produced the identical result: T_A = 2L/v < T_C = 2L/√(v²−u²) < T_B = 2Lv/(v²−u²), the naive-cancellation refutation via reciprocal convexity, single-trip blindness, and the differential second-order probe (ΔT ≈ L·u²/v³). The pure baseline delivered it faster and more elegantly but asserted the second-order structure and the frame-invariance consequence without proof-by-limits or an explicit assumption inventory; the AI verified limits (u→0, u→v), derived ratios, documented the idealization as assumptions, and made the observer-epistemology point explicit. The AI's only gap is efficiency: stage narration and a decision packet for a problem whose core is one page of algebra.
learning_signal: For idealized-scenario (thought-experiment) problems, the load-bearing moves are exactly: (1) state the idealization explicitly and what it deletes; (2) run the idealized world symbolically — here the harmonic structure T = L/(v−u) + L/(v+u) = 2Lv/(v²−u²), not arithmetic averaging; (3) refute the seductive intuition with the convexity argument (loss upstream > gain downstream); (4) verify with limits (u→0, u→v) and ratios; (5) extract the principle, including the epistemology layer (what can an observer inside the scenario actually infer?) — here single-trip blindness, differential probe, second-order sensitivity. On this class the agent already matches the elite style; the benchmark to close is one-pass economy, not correctness.
suggested_improvement: In the META route, add a fast-path rule for fully-idealized symbolic problems (no measurement, no external action): compress the process to 'idealization statement -> symbolic derivation -> limit verification -> principle extraction (incl. observer-epistemology)' and skip extended stage narration; keep the explicit assumptions line and the limits check as the packet's core, which is what earned the marginal edge. Reserve the full stage structure for problems with empirical or incomplete inputs.

key_gap: The pure thought-experiment baseline derived the voting paradox with textbook rigor — p ≈ 1/N ≈ 10⁻⁷, EV(vote) = p·b − c ≈ −$10 (negative by ~5 orders of magnitude), turnout ≈ 0, 'democracy is irrational and collapses' — and stopped: idealization drift, the stripped instrumental-only utility function treated as the real world, no empirical check. The AI ran the same idealized core, then performed the check the style skips: measured turnout is 50–90% (US 2020 ≈ 66.8%; non-compulsory Denmark/Sweden ≈ 84%), falsifying the prediction by ~60 points; it identified the drift precisely (deleted expressive/duty/social utility — supported by field experiments showing social-pressure mailers raise turnout ~8 points), retained the intact logical core (the free-rider/collective-action structure of voting), repaired the conclusion ('norms and expressive value sustain participation', with the small-N scope where pivotal probability is real), and never presented the idealized conclusion as a fact about the world.
learning_signal: Gedankenexperiment conclusions are conditional on what the idealization deleted; after any idealized-scenario derivation the agent must run a mandatory empirical gate: (a) what measurement/base rate exists for the conclusion (here: turnout); (b) is the model's prediction falsified by it — a divergence of orders of magnitude (5 orders in EV, ~60 points of turnout) means a misspecified model, not a discovery; (c) which deletion caused the drift (here: instrumental-only utility) and which part of the logical core survives the repair (here: the free-rider structure — retain it); (d) never present an idealized conclusion as a statement about the world without the gate. The scenario's cheapness is preserved — the derivation is one line; the gate is what makes it trustworthy.
suggested_improvement: Add a mandatory 'empirical check' sub-step to the WHY/HOW gates for any idealization-heavy route (scenario-based reasoning): after the derivation, require one falsifying measurement or base rate for the conclusion and record the divergence in the decision packet; if no measurement exists, demote the status to APPROXIMATED or NEEDS_EVIDENCE rather than SOLVED, and label the conclusion as 'model-conditional'. This converts the human model's known weakness (no empirical check) into a process invariant and would have caught the trap answer automatically.
